insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual/Family Floater: 5L to 3 Cr (plan-wise). Family First: Base individual SI 1L to 15L + floater SI as per formula (plan-wise).

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy..
great.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 24 months from the start of the policy. You must wait 2 years before claims for pre-existing conditions are covered.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: If your base sum insured is used up, the insurer provides an extra sum insured up to 100% of the base amount once per policy year. This gives you extra coverage for additional claims.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 90 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
great.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days before hospitalization are covered if related to the hospitalization. This longer period helps cover more pre-admission costs.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents which are covered immediately. This is a standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures are excluded for 12 months from policy start. This is better than the usual 24 months waiting.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered if related to the hospitalization. This duration is standard to good in the market.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room rent Covered up to Sum Insured (except for Suite or above room category)
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Individual & Family Floater variant)
good.explanation: Room rent is covered up to the sum insured for standard rooms, excluding suites. This means no fixed daily cap for normal rooms.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions in the form of Cumulative Bonus by increasing the Sum Insured applicable under the Policy by 10% of the Base Sum Insured ... subject to a maximum of 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Sum insured increases by 10% each year without a break, up to 100% extra. The bonus likely does not reset to zero after a claim, preserving your coverage.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Treatment at home when medically necessary is covered on reimbursement basis. This helps when hospital admission is not possible.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: Modern Treatments Covered up to Sum Insured with sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.25 (Modern Treatments) special condition
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered but some robotic surgeries have a sub-limit of Rs. 1 lakh. This means coverage is mostly good but some limits apply.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure VII – The expenses that are not covered or subsumed...
bad.explanation: Many common consumables like gloves and masks are excluded, causing you to pay out-of-pocket during hospitalization.

bad.name: Room Rent Cap
bad.quote: Room rent Option 1: Rs 3,000 per day or Shared Room; whichever is lower Option 2: Rs 5,000 per day or Single Private Room; whichever is lower
bad.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Family First variant – Silver)
bad.explanation: For the Family First Silver variant, room rent is capped daily at Rs 3,000 or Rs 5,000 depending on room type, which can increase your out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: A limit of maximum INR 1 Lac will apply to all robotic surgeries, except the following...
bad.reference: Section 3.25 (Modern Treatments) – Special condition applicable for robotic surgeries
bad.explanation: Certain procedures like robotic surgeries have a maximum coverage limit of Rs. 1 lakh, reducing effective coverage compared to policies without such caps.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) shall be applied on the amount payable by Us.
bad.explanation: Co-payment may apply depending on your policy schedule and zone, but the default co-pay percentage is not clearly stated. Check your policy details to confirm.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
